subject: VOLCANIC ASH EXERCISE VOLCEX26 WILL TAKE PLACE ON 18 NOVEMBER
text:
A4266/26 NOTAMN
Q) LGGG/QWWLW/IV/NBO/W /000/999/3705N02445E341
A) LGGG B) 2611180800 C) 2611181600
E) VOLCANIC ASH EXERCISE VOLCEX26 WILL TAKE PLACE ON 18 NOVEMBER 
2026 FROM
08:00 UTC TO 16:00 UTC.
THE EXERCISE WILL SIMULATE A CONTINUOUS ERUPTION OF VESUVIO VOLCANO 
IN
NAPLES (ITALY), WITH DISPERSION OF CONTAMINATING ASH CLOUDS.
DURING THE EXERCISE A NUMBER OF MESSAGES (VONA, NOTAM, VAA, SIGMET) 
WILL BE
ISSUED AND WILL START WITH THE WARNING EXERCISE VOLCEX26 EXERCISE  
AND END
WITH A WARNING EXERCISE  EXERCISE  EXERCISE.
UPON RECEIVING THESE MESSAGES, AIRCRAFT OPERATORS SHALL NOT TAKE ANY
ACTION. ALL EXERCISE ACTIONS AND PROCEDURES SHALL NOT AFFECT REAL 
LIFE
OPERATIONS.
IN THE EVENT OF AN ACTUAL VOLCANIC ERUPTION THE EXERCISE WILL BE 
TERMINATED.
F) GND G) UNL
